term: shared truth/falsity matrices for K3 and LP
definition: A local two-atom Formula grammar has object negation, conjunction and disjunction. Values are Boolean truth/falsity pairs. Negation swaps the bits; conjunction ANDs truth and ORs falsity; disjunction ORs truth and ANDs falsity. Designated reads the truth bit. K3 excludes Both at atoms; LP excludes Neither. Consequence preserves designation over every admitted valuation from a finite premise list.
note: Analyst reconstruction #1084, attribution deferred. Same syntax and tables for both profiles. Both is not Lean P and not-P; no established floor principle or historical attribution changes. Existing Boolean-negation and Heyting semantics do not have these meanings. This is no general logic platform or global completeness claim; docs/notes/plural-closure-boundary-1084.md.
